algorithm_title: Design a memory buffer that holds a fixed number of items. When it runs out of space it must discard the item
evidence_summary: This suite retains three deterministic seeded LRU state sequences. A non-positive capacity boundary is declared separately, but automatic boundary observation remains unavailable until a safe generic LRU adapter is defined.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on 3 core Common Test cases plus any separately declared semantic-boundary probes; boundary probes do not contribute to core behavioural accuracy.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy as evidence within the frozen semantic contract. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive evidence of out-of-domain acceptance.
coverage_limitations: Deterministic seeded runs exercise LRU state behaviour, but the generic semantic adapter does not yet support direct hand-crafted LRU operation sequences. Non-positive capacity is declared as a boundary probe but remains automatically NOT_EVALUABLE until a safe generic LRU adapter is added.

semantic_contract.task_statement: Design a memory buffer that discards the least recently accessed item when full.

result.canonical_semantics: Buffer state after accesses/additions with least-recently-used eviction.
